question: In whose presence should the practitioner offer prayer to the deity?
premises: Prayer to the deity is prescribed.
The alternatives are direct presence or the presence of the guru.
inference: One should pray to the deity either in direct presence or before the guru.
uncertainties: Whether samakṣam implies presence of the deity's image is not explicit.
plain_english: One should pray to the deity either in direct presence or in the presence of the guru.
